kind: Independent read-only source and actual TDD evidence review of maintained-text ASCII control rejection

minimality.production_AST: Only check_text changed; all other functions/classes and existing selection/exclusion/debt/ownership code retained.
minimality.old_tests: All 35 old class methods, including29 test methods, are AST-identical to exact authoring-base Git object. New3 TextHygiene tests plus1 staged CLI test give whole33.

source_assessment: check_text retains initial NUL-byte ValueError, UTF-8 strict decoding, CR LF-ending diagnostic, and missing-final-LF diagnostic. It scans decoded characters for only U+0001..U+001F except TAB/LF/CR, plus ASCII DEL U+007F. Existing CR diagnostic handles CR rather than duplicate ASCII-control errors. There is no Unicode category/bidi expansion or regex execution against unselected raw output.

LF alone advances reported source line numbers. Vertical tab, form feed, file/group/record separator characters no longer create fake lines or trailing-space evidence. Exact ASCII diagnostics include the maintained relative path, LF line number and code point. The class includes the actual0x08 Doxygen corruption discovered in SPI comments.

TAB and LF are not forbidden; valid UTF-8 prose remains decodable. Python compile checking follows the existing text checks. Literal source escapes such as backslash-b contain no hidden control byte and remain governed by normal language syntax, not this scan.

The Markdown trailing-space exemption remains. Non-Markdown trailing spaces/tabs at real LF boundaries are rejected as before. Removing terminal CR before checking whitespace preserves existing CRLF trailing-whitespace behavior, while the independent CR diagnostic always rejects CR.

run_checks file selection, tracked/index requirements, source ownership, vendor exclusions, sealed debt checks, and text suffixes are unchanged. The new staged test executes the real CLI: four maintained suffixes fail for actual backspace, .log/.bin and vendors exclusion stay ignored, and an untracked .txt does not enter the selection. No historical debt rebaseline or new ignore rule was introduced.

The scan has no write path and does not rewrite or sanitize bytes. Its policy applies to existing selected maintained text, which includes .txt; it does not claim that arbitrary execution logs named .txt are universally exempt. The preserved feature raw files are .log / unselected attempt outputs, and all28 protected files remain byte-identical.

bounded_whitespace_semantic_change.observation: Old str.splitlines also split at Unicode NEL U+0085, LINE SEPARATOR U+2028 and PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR U+2029. New LF-only splitting does not. Thus a space immediately before such an embedded separator can cease to be reported as trailing whitespace in non-Markdown text.
bounded_whitespace_semantic_change.example_read_only_reasoning: Text SPACE U+2028 tail LF was two logical splitlines lines before; it is now one LF line whose interior space is not trailing. No test or implementation was executed by this reviewer to infer this; it follows directly from the changed split API.
bounded_whitespace_semantic_change.assessment: Consistent with the repository LF line-boundary rule and avoids interpreting allowed Unicode prose as physical source lines. Do not describe it as preserving every old Unicode-separator whitespace diagnostic. This does not introduce acceptance of forbidden ASCII controls or CR, which have their own nonzero diagnostics.

red.reason: 29 forbidden-ASCII subtests lacked the new required diagnostic plus real staged hidden-backspace acceptance regression. Existing NUL/CR and valid UTF8/TAB/LF checks passed.

actual_TDD.preservation: Exact final test bytes are present in red-source and final-source; RED production matches base39ee6a0b, GREEN productionfbff5470. Maintained process.run full unittest module command has no filter/subset; actual completed receipts, stdout/stderr sizes and SHA match the full retained log endings.

independent_evidence_readback.protected_scope: Four separately published HSI WIP files,23 old s0-evidence files, and exact Git index; before/after HEAD identity claims match the authoring-base scope. Reviewer did not repeat an actual live HEAD/status command or infer full-tree qualification.
independent_evidence_readback.prior_tests: 35 existing class methods preserved by AST comparison to exact Git source object.
independent_evidence_readback.reviewer_operations: Small read-only source/AST/hash/raw receipt inspection only; no test, compilation, configure, formatter, helper execution, source/main/index/ref change, or subagent was used.

limits: Whole scripts.ci.test_style_gate module is the only new executed qualification. Complete main normal hooks/CI remain separate.

This ASCII check catches literal backspace corruption but cannot prove Doxygen semantics or detect a note command accidentally split using an otherwise valid LF; SPI comment-only corrections still need their own byte review.
No firmware, ARM, SDK, physical timing, hardware or HIL claim follows from this tool change.
